email.subject: Smile Co's site is likely losing you new patients
email.body:
Hi Marcus,

I looked at Smile Co Dentistry's website. Two things are probably costing you patients: there's no way to book an appointment online, so anyone searching after hours just moves to the next dentist, and the site isn't mobile-friendly, which is how most people find a dentist nearby in the first place. Your footer and office hours also look out of date, which can make people second-guess calling.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee, no retainer. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what I'd change and why.

Worth a quick look?

Alex
Northlight Web
